budget_basis: Planned pre-run estimate, NOT a measurement. Assumes ~2.4M GPT-2 tokens in the WikiText-2 raw train split after upstream's group-into-blocks preprocessing (block_size=512), 1 epoch per generation, 11 generations. With human_data_alpha=0.0 only generation 0 consumes human tokens, so lifetime_human_budget = one epoch of human data. The adapter records measured token totals from the executed run and expected_vs_observed.md must reconcile the two.

model.revision_policy: Upstream pins no revision (config/model/gpt2.yaml). The executing host must resolve and record the Hugging Face commit SHA; the adapter refuses to leave status=planned while this sentinel is unresolved.

data.train_manifest_note: Re-pinned 2026-08-06 under the frozen stack (transformers 4.48.3, datasets 3.2.0). The previous value was produced under transformers 5.15.0.dev0 / datasets 5.0.0, an environment since rejected because upstream cannot run on it. load_data.py:150 runs the ModernBERT detector over the training split, so train.json depends on the framework stack and on GPU inference. See FAILURE_LOG.md PC-2026-08-06-F.

data_selection.deviation_note: Overrides upstream's importance_sampling default. See PROTOCOL.md, 'Recorded deviation from the upstream default configuration'.

expected.ordering_note: This arm is expected to show the LARGER degradation ratio of the two arms. The comparison itself is frozen in PROTOCOL.md, 'Frozen endpoint, ordering, and tolerance'.
